procedural_matters: The technical committee was represented by Ulrich Vogelmaier.
Torbjörn Svenson (coach 218) did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
SWE 223149 (Robin Svensson) did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Right after the finish of Race 1, Mr. Torbjörn Svenson(support person 218) was not wearing the kill cord.
After beeing reminded by the technical committee that he isobliged to wear the killcord, Mr. Torbjörn Svenson wore the kill cord.
conclusions: By not wearing the kill cord while the engine was running, Mr. Torbjörn Svenson broke ESTR 3.2.
Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines forBoats and Support Persons a starting penalty of level 2 was decided.
Although the breach could have affected safety, the supportperson promptly remedied the breach; the level 2 will hence stand.
decision: Mr. Torbjörn Svenson shall stay ashore until the first race of his supported boat(s) on June 27th has started.
